newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Inner Mongolian firm to list A shares in Shenzhen.
newsitem.headline: Inner Mongolian firm to list A shares in Shenzhen.

text.p: Inner Mongolia Yuanxing Natural Alkali Co Ltd will list 58.50 million A shares on the Shenzhen bourse on January 30, a company spokesman told the Hong Kong-based newsletter China Securities Bulletin on Thursday.
The offer, which was launched at 5.11 yuan per share via the Shenzhen exchange's automated quotation system earlier this month, was 68.49 times over-subscribed, the official said.
The company at the same time issued 6.50 million staff shares but the stock will not be listed until six months following the flotation of the A shares, he said.
The company said in its prospectus that it would use most of the money raised from the issues to explore natural gas resources in Inner Mongolia and acquire a local chemical plant.
The prospectus said the company estimated its 1996 net profits at 68.75 million yuan, compared with 47.16 million yuan in 1995 and 11.13 million yuan a year earlier.
The company had audited after-tax profits of 52.23 million yuan in the January-September period of 1996, it said.
Yuanxing has a total share capital of 215 million shares, composed of 150 million legal person shares, 58.50 million A shares and 6.50 million staff shares.
